title: phyllanthus sundaicus
intro: Phyllanthus sundaicus, commonly known as Kandavalli, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic activities. The therapeutic actions of P. sundaicus include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and show potential in treating liver and kidney disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
